abstract: Oversees biomethane grid injection infrastructure and pipeline pressurization standards
system_message:
You are the Energy and grid interconnection coordinator (GRID), responsible for overseeing biomethane grid injection infrastructure, utility compliance assessments, and pipeline pressurization standards across candidate digestion facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees biomethane grid injection infrastructure and pipeline pressurization standards（INJ）
information_points.content:
GRID-INJ-UUA：For the Continuous stirred-tank wet digestion facility, the regional gas pipeline injection interconnection is approved for the high-pressure biomethane injection substation.
GRID-INJ-R3D：For the Two-stage thermophilic dry fermentation complex, the regional gas pipeline injection interconnection is not approved for the high-pressure biomethane injection substation.
GRID-INJ-OVP：For the High-solids plug-flow digestion plant, the regional gas pipeline injection interconnection is approved for the high-pressure biomethane injection substation.

information_points.title: Electrical auxiliary consumption（POWER）
information_points.content:
GRID-POWER-ZSO：For the High-solids plug-flow digestion plant, telemetry records show a substation transformer standby power draw of 34 kW for the dedicated interconnection step-up transformer during non-injection idle status.
GRID-POWER-VQC：For the Two-stage thermophilic dry fermentation complex, telemetry records show a substation transformer standby power draw of 46 kW for the dedicated interconnection step-up transformer during non-injection idle status.
GRID-POWER-MCU：For the Continuous stirred-tank wet digestion facility, telemetry records show a substation transformer standby power draw of 22 kW for the dedicated interconnection step-up transformer during non-injection idle status.
